content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The architecture of crypto payment gateways for digital products enables creators to transact without relying on traditional financial institutions. This is particularly crucial for those in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or charge exorbitant fees. Using NOWPayments, for instance, incurs only a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%. This not only improves profit margins for creators but also reinstates full control over their transactions and data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a crypto payment gateway utilizes blockchain technology to facilitate transactions. When a customer purchases a digital product, the payment is processed on-chain, leveraging networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON for efficient and low-fee transactions. The integration of Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers allows for automated order fulfillment, ensuring that digital products are delivered instantly upon payment confirmation. This architecture not only streamlines operations but also enhances the overall customer experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is designed for digital creators across various sectors, including ebook authors, course developers, and template designers who face payment restrictions. By utilizing a sovereign commerce infrastructure, these creators can operate independently of traditional payment platforms, which often impose high fees or account limitations. The system is especially beneficial for creators in countries like Zimbabwe or Ethiopia, where financial isolation is prevalent. It empowers them to monetize their work without compromising on fees or control.
NOWPayments' 0.5% fee is a game changer for creators.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A successful digital commerce stack consists of several components: hosting via GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and order management through Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery can be handled via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, while NOWPayments provides the crypto payment processing. Each component works in harmony to create a seamless experience for both the creator and the customer, ensuring that transactions are efficient and cost-effective.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your crypto payment gateway, start by selecting your hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages. Next, set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage transactions. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing, ensuring you choose a network with low transaction fees. Finally, organize your product delivery method, utilizing Google Drive for file hosting. This comprehensive approach allows you to launch your digital store and keep more of your earnings.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Instant product delivery means happier customers.

This kit provides all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to build a sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate crypto payments into my digital store?

To integrate crypto payments, choose a payment processor like NOWPayments and follow their integration guidelines. You'll typically need to set up an API connection between your store and the payment processor to facilitate transaction processing.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This flexibility helps you cater to a broader audience.
How are fees different between NOWPayments and traditional platforms?
NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charge up to 10%. This difference can save you substantial revenue over time.
Can I automate product delivery?
Yes, using tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the delivery of digital products. This ensures instant access for customers upon payment confirmation.
What if I need help setting this up?
For assistance, consider purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes comprehensive documentation and templates to help you set up your sovereign commerce stack quickly.
